findings.summary: Reuse the existing data-engine-stubs.cpp factories in the generated warning-contract executable tests.
Share SceneNode vector component projection between direct property reads and retained handle aliases, preserving their component metadata.
Use the switch-narrowed CSG2 operation directly instead of searching the operation list and asserting a result.
Prefilter CSG source identifiers by spelling before checking resolved-symbol identity.
Emit try/catch directly when no finally block requires body capture and reordered native guard emission.
Consolidate numeric, vector and reference-struct conditional dispatch through the common sink while preserving static Value metadata and compiling the predicate once.
Use the shared matrix lowerer inline option in the shadow header instead of rewriting its generated signature.
Remove the unused PAL ray distance field and duplicate square root while retaining the public pinned double-precision distance.
Use transparent visibility candidates as the sole sorting source and rebuild the visible commands from it.
Cache the physics ray trace switch once per process using the existing runtime trace convention.
Move the completed nullable raycast body into the returned result to avoid another ownership-handle copy.

reviewExecution: Four independent agents inherited the parent model. Three initial angles ran concurrently and the fourth ran when a slot became available; all completed before fixes. All four angles reviewed subsequent optional getter, fresh-container indexing and numeric conditional corrections. The final conditional consolidation was then independently rechecked under all four angles, with no further findings. Follow-up reviews used available host slots, including sequential passes. All six findings were applied. The final deterministic Tint stream correction received separate reuse, simplification, efficiency and altitude passes with no findings. The host could reactivate only two review agents, so each performed a second distinct angle pass after its first completed. Checkpoint two builds on that reviewed checkpoint. Three agents inherited the same model for reuse, simplification and efficiency on scene103; a separate altitude pass followed in a reused slot due the host limit. All four completed before the five deduplicated findings were applied. A separate correctness review checked the pinned contracts and recorded the preexisting trigger-filter limitation as A30.
